prompt: You are a senior reviewer. Review the deliverable-under-review below for real defects only: correctness bugs, spec violations (docs/SPEC.md), concurrency/resource leaks, error handling that hides failures, security issues (e.g. token comparison, header injection, hop-by-hop handling), and test gaps. For each finding give: severity (high/medium/low), file:line, what breaks (a concrete failure scenario), and the minimal fix. Do not list style nits. Write the review as markdown with a '## Findings' section (write '## Findings\n\nNone.' if there are none) and a '## Verdict' line. Deliverable under review: agents/bench.py (async load benchmark used by @cutover-gate: 500 requests, concurrency 50, p50/p95/p99).
